facts.text: SO101LiftCube-v1 is registered through mani_skill.utils.registration.register_env with max_episode_steps=50, and LiftCube fixes item_type to cube
The Lift environment defaults to robot_uids='so101' and control_mode='pd_joint_target_delta_pos'

The pd_joint_target_delta_pos controller is the six-joint delta controller (use_delta=True): its lower bounds are -0.1 for the five arm joints and -0.2 for the gripper, and its upper bounds are 0.1 and 0.2; it does not set normalize_action, and the target variant only sets use_target=True
The default simulation config is SimConfig(sim_freq=100, control_freq=10): one control step advances 0.1 s of simulated time
The trainer renders at render_size 128 and downsamples the policy input to image_size 16
The state observation includes qvel, is_item_grasped, item_pose, tcp_pos, the item-to-tcp vector and the joint target distance to the rest pose
Success requires the item to be lifted, grasped and the arm to be within 0.2 of the rest joint pose

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial joint and item state, and the stand-in's step is deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the upstream environment draws from numpy/torch generators and simulates contacts, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: the fake is kinematic/analytic: the six joint targets add the scaled action deltas (a value in -1..1 times 0.1 for an arm joint and 0.2 for the gripper, envs/robot/so101.py:97-109) and are reached at once, with no rigid-body dynamics, contact, friction, actuator response, sensor noise or domain randomization

the fake returns a 4x4x3 placeholder RGB frame and a 10-number state vector; the upstream wrist camera renders 128x128 (envs/base_random_env.py:521-527) and its state layout depends on obs_mode and the ManiSkill version (envs/lift.py:328-341)
no camera render, segmentation, overlay or colour jitter is modelled
the upstream env is truncated by the registered max_episode_steps=50; the stand-in truncates at the same step count but does not reproduce ManiSkill's time-limit wrapper
the fake was not compared with the upstream ManiSkill environment (ManiSkill/SAPIEN were not installed where the gate ran)

the step bounds -1..1 have no source: the controller config sets no normalize_action, and ManiSkill, which this clone does not contain, defaults it to True, serves Box(-1, 1) of the controller's shape and scales each value to the deltas (mani_skill/agents/controllers/pd_joint_pos.py:131, base_controller.py:70-72, mani_skill/utils/gym_utils.py:104-112, read in the ManiSkill clone at 62ff3a58); environment.yaml:15 installs an unpinned mani_skill_nightly
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
